english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for making, creating, cooking, or putting together something such as a plan.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 zing2 daan6 gou1

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for making or producing a practical thing, including creating a result from materials or ingredients.

exampleSentences.english: I used leftover rice to create fried rice.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 di1 sing6 faan6 zing2 zo2 caau2 faan6

english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose verb for repairing things or preparing food and drink.

exampleSentences.english: I can fix us a cup of coffee.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 zing2 bui1 gaa3 fe1

english.note: Use 整 for casually making or getting food ready, especially when the emphasis is preparation rather than a specific cooking method.

exampleSentences.english: I prepare a sandwich for breakfast tomorrow morning.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我聽朝整個三文治做早餐。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 ziu1 zing2 go3 saam1 man4 zi6 zou6 zou2 caan1

english.note: Use 整 for casually making, preparing, or cooking something for someone.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll do some cooking and make you congee tonight.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 zing2 zuk1 bei2 nei5 sik6
